comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: As a documentary video editor, I really appreciate the scriptwriting and visual layering here. In image_23fbd3.jpg, showing the vibrant, resilient Sega dancers [14:05] while the narration talks about "every dish carries the footprints of the people" [14:56] perfectly merges the visual of their culture with the auditory story of their survival. It’s a beautiful way to show how art and food both came from the same history of migration and slavery. To answer your question [20:36]: Yes, absolutely! I would love to visit Mauritius someday. 🇲🇺🎥
